answer: Start from zero-knowledge proof of unique personhood. Every identity must clear it before its first answer counts. Faking 379 identities means 379 fresh proofs and 42827 POA at risk, while the honest path risks nothing but a few minutes. Hold the meadow up to the light, weigh the vertex of the attack, and keep the falcon of the verdict where everyone can audit it. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
